notes.title: Patch v1.0.8 You can keybind Game Controllers now
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

A couple of small changes. 

Players can now keybind their controller. I had the code from the Xbox port and was meaning to add this to the PC version. In settings, you can now customize your controller keybinds. 

When you are using your game controller you will see the icons change and you can go into settings with your controller to change the keybindings (note the game looks for an active controller, so if you don't have one you cant change them). It'll make sense when you mess with it.

A couple of other small changes.

-The blue dot for the sight on the stun gun would smudge when moving if motion blur was on, now it remains clear. 
-I fixed a really minor bug on Krampus during the final boss fight where his laser eye attack would sometimes not show the warning laser before firing. 

That is all for now.

-DangerousBob

notes.title: Patch v 1.0.7 Health Regen
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I have noticed in several youtube videos that players would get down to low health and then get in a situation where they just went through a checkpoint but now have to fight a bunch of enemies and they have no health items.

So I have decided to add a modern health regen when health is under 50%. *
*The health items will still be needed to get back to full health.

[list]
[*]When health is low, health will automatically regenerate to 50% after 5 seconds (10 seconds on Nightmare Difficulty). 
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 Fix Achievement Cache Problem
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

As some have noted, there have been some issues with achievements unlocking properly. 
This seems to be from a cache problem on Steam side.

I have coded a workaround that checks for the achievements in the main menu (and after every load screen). If you are having issues with an achievement, try to unlock the achievement you are missing again and it should unlock now after a load screen (ie a map change or returning to the main menu).

notes.title: v1.0.2 Week One Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Krampus Kills is off to a good start. Your feedback has been great and seeing the massive number of youtube videos come out featuring the game content is awesome! 

This update patches a few small bugs / changes:

-An error when you beat the game, the ending screen text would say "Naughty", not "Nightmare" if you were in fact on the Nightmare difficulty. This was confusing players.
-A save point outside the Hospital which was missing, has been put back in (on the park bench).
-In CastleKrampus when you fight the giant skeleton on the bridge, a candy cane wall now comes up behind you. This small change was done because I felt that that encounter was not dangerous enough, as players could backtrack onto the bridge and outrun the giant.

I would also like to say we have some new leaderboard leaders!!

That is all for now.
Have a happy holiday everyone!

[h1]Changes in this patch: [/h1]

notes.title: Update v.62 - New Enemy, & New Ability
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

This update has got some cool stuff. 

New enemy: [i]The Kamikaze Hell Elf[/i], a blue elf that runs at you and explodes. 

New ability: Players now get an "upgrade" by finding a green candy cane, the sugar rush upgrade allows players to run faster and double jump. 

The decision to add this upgrade was made because the second half of the game is more action-oriented. I also felt speed runners could have some fun with it.

notes.title: Update V0.61
notes.notes:
Just some small changes as we get into the home stretch to release out of Early Access at the end of the Fall. 

Mostly just polishing the UI and Settings. 

Settings now save when you restart that game. 

A few small gameplay tweaks. Krampus laser eye attack has been tweaked so it is not so buggy in the final boss fight. 

The front door doesn't open now in the house. Players were going outside and getting lost when getting outside was supposed to be an easter egg. Players now have to go out the backdoor if they want to find the SMG easter egg.

notes.title: Update V0.60
notes.notes:
Hello, all you winter demon-shooter fans,

A few small tweaks with this update. 

-The Flame Bottle acts less like a grenade, and more like a proper Molotov, breaking on impact when thrown vs rolling. 

-Ragdoll on the Elves has been improved. 

-A few minor map changes on the Arena in terms of placement of the flame trap.

notes.title: Update v0.59 Survivor map change
notes.notes:
Hello, all you horror shooter fans!

The map for the Survivor mode has been swapped out. People didn't seem to like the House map, so a Hell Battle Arena was added. This map has been custom created for Survivor mode in mind! 

If you feel that the House map should stay, please comment to let me know.

The map features traps you can use against enemies and a dynamic design which will encourage high-intensity combat. The enemy waves have been slightly adjusted. Enemies will appear sooner and Krampus will appear in his Boss form. 

[b]The new Survivor Battle Arena. [/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/9SqRcsO.png[/img]

notes.title: Update V0.58 New Mini-Game "Hide and Seek" + Achievement!
notes.notes:
Hey, all you horror fans, Merry Christmas in July.. err June. 

I was recently inspired by some horror gameplay from a [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3CQCG8jPuW8&t=3s]garrys mod game I saw on youtube[/url] and decided to add in a new mini-game to Krampus Kills.

Overview:

[h2]Hide and Seek[/h2]

In Hide and Seek, Krampus has trapped you in the forest with a spell. You must find 3 grandfather clocks that are placed in random locations and destroy them to escape. Krampus will be hunting you the entire time. His speed and senses have been sharpened higher than what they are in the main game. If you hear his roar you need to find a hiding place immediately. 

Hide and Seek comes with its own achievement. 


[previewyoutube=M54BvjMjV-k;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]




[h1]Other news:[/h1]

The Speed Run Leaderboard has been reset. Given that many changes have been made to the main game, the overall time to complete is different now vs earlier patches. 

Given that the game is in Early Access, it was stated that these changes would be coming. 

A[b] Nightmare mode Speed Run Leaderboard[/b] has been added in the Steam stats. 
Given that Nightmare mode changes the main game significantly and has a longer ending, I felt that it needed its own Speed Run board.

notes.title: V0.57 UPDATE Some big tweaks, some small tweaks
notes.notes:
Hello, all you horror shooter fans!

The following changes have been made to Krampus Kills. 

[list]
[*] New Item: Alarm Clock. Allows the player to use Slow Motion. The item is rare and hidden only on a few maps.
[*] Krampus has a new attack. [i]Homelander[/i]-style laser eyes (not on Easy mode) during the boss battle.
[*] Krampus health has been buffed in the boss battle.
[*] Your Stamina lasts longer while running and recovers faster. 
[*] Snowmen can throw snowballs at you now from a distance.
[*] The Flame Bottle has been nerfed on the damage it does to Krampus, though still the most effective. 
[*] The Stun Gun works on the Snowmen now.
[*] The SnowGlobes glow, this should make it easier to find them. 
[/list]

notes.title: V0.55 Update - Minor tweaking
notes.notes:
Hello, all you horror shooter fans!

Just doing some detailed tweaking. 
Mainly on the Nightmare and Hard difficulty in regards to enemy placement. 

The Cemetery map varies a lot now based on difficulty. I felt that was the weakest level in the game so I am focusing on cleaning it up.  

Added more ammo to the game, as players seemed to be getting low in youtube run-throughs on higher difficulties.

notes.title: Patch 0.3 - fixed the crash bug on Oak Park level.
notes.notes:
There was an issue on Oak Park where the game would crash the second time the map was loaded. This was caused by something called tessellation on a large landscape texture.

This has been fixed. 

Other changes,
The Cemetery is slightly harder now with some more enemies.

notes.title: Release day tweaks! v0.2 Krampus ai tweak.
notes.notes:
Hello! Thank you all for playing. 

Krampus Ai has been slightly tweaked so that he is a little easier to escape from. 
If you manage to stay out of his sight for 20 seconds, he will enter his search mode again and go back to walking his patrol.
